services.desc: The Ruth and Nathan Hale Theater, affectionately known as The Ruth at doTERRA, is a state-of-the-art performing arts facility that is the new home of The Hale Center Theater Orem (HCTO). HCTO operated in Orem from 1990 to 2024. Our state-of-the-art facility officially opened its doors on January 4, 2025 on the doTERRA campus in Pleasant Grove. The Ruth and Nathan Hale Theater is named after the original founders of the Hale Center Theater Orem. Ruth and Nathan also founded 3 other Hale family-founded theaters in the mountain west.
